scope: Dependency advisory triage and enquiry storage/external URL source review

dependency_review.exposure: Development lint tooling only. Installed @next/eslint-plugin-next invokes fast-glob for next.rootDir glob patterns from trusted local ESLint configuration. This project does not configure next.rootDir. No connection to public visitor input was found.
dependency_review.recommendation: Retain the lockfile and current Next versions. Record the unresolved dev-only advisory and revisit when an official patch is published. No same-package override can remove the advisory today. Do not apply npm audit fix --force or the suggested eslint-config-next downgrade to 14.2.35.
commands: npm view braces version dist-tags time.modified repository --json

application_review.enquiry_persistence: None found. FormData and React state remain in the browser; no API handler, server action, database, localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, cookie write, fetch, or beacon submission was found in application source.
application_review.external_handoff: Validated fields build an HTTPS wa.me link. The user reviews the draft, opens WhatsApp, and sends there. No automatic message sending occurs.
application_review.user_input_handling: WhatsApp number constrained to digits; all message values encoded with encodeURIComponent; dates/counts/lengths validated; query-selected room slug resolved against the local room list.
application_review.external_urls: Static hotel map, official destination references, photographer/license credits, WhatsApp privacy, and Digiocular credit. No user-controlled external navigation destination found.
application_review.html_injection: Only dangerouslySetInnerHTML use is static Hotel JSON-LD; '<' escaped as Unicode. No enquiry input enters HTML injection sinks.
application_review.headers: Baseline CSP, nosniff, DENY framing, referrer policy, disabled camera/microphone/geolocation, and HSTS configured. CSP is baseline hardening, not a strict script allowlist.
application_review.limitations: Source review and dependency triage do not constitute a penetration test. WhatsApp public landing was inspected separately; this does not prove number registration or hotel account ownership.
